title: Flash Attention (Tiled)
hint: Process Q in blocks. For each Q-block, iterate over K/V blocks. Use online softmax: track running max and sum, rescale accumulator when max changes. output = acc / row_sum.

description.text: Implement memory-efficient tiled attention in pure PyTorch: process Q, K, V in blocks and use an online softmax (running max and sum) so you never materialize the full attention matrix for long sequences.

constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
